title: CI templates: actions/checkout v7.0.1 and setup-uv v10.2.0, pinned by SHA
head: ci-template-actions
body:
## What

Bumps the actions in the repo CI templates, pinned by full commit SHA (AGENTS.md: never a moving tag):

- `template/python/.github/workflows/ci.yml`: `actions/checkout` v4 -> v7.0.1, `astral-sh/setup-uv` v6 -> v10.2.0.
- `template/desktop/.github/workflows/ci.yml`: `actions/checkout` v4 -> v7.0.1.
- `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased entry. No version bump (templates are not in the wheel).

setup-uv v7-v10 breaking changes checked: node24 runtime (GitHub-hosted runners are fine), cache pruning off by default, and `enable-cache: auto` now turns the cache off for some events. The template sets `enable-cache: true`, and `python-version` still exists, so it behaves the same.

The repo's own `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is unchanged.

## Checks (rerun by coordinator)

- `ruff check .` clean
- `pytest -q` passed
- `git diff --check` clean
